Name: Tego's Less Vibrant Dirt and Grass
Author: Gundulka
Description:
[b][u]NOTICE: I have no intention in working on the mod. Please contact me if you wish to do it yourself.[/u][/b]

The mod changes the color of yellow dirt to be brownish and more natural during spring and summer. Also makes grass a lot less vibrant to stop hurting our eyes (Optional file leaves grass and changes only dirt).  
Also the color of maple tree is changed from weirdly pink.[b]

[b]Be sure to check out my other mods: [/b][url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/284/?tab=1&navtag=http%3A%2F%2Fwww.nexusmods.com%2Fstardewvalley%2Fajax%2Fmoddescription%2F%3Fid%3D284%26preview%3D&pUp=1][b]Stardew Valley [/b][b]Expansion[/b][/url][/b]
Have fun!

Installation:
1. Extract the downloaded archive
[i]2.[/i] Make a backup of "Stardew Valley\Content\Maps" and "Stardew Valley\Content\TerrainFeatures"
3. Copy the "Content" folder from the mod to your Stardew Valley directory (chosing overwrite).
